Pre-market is already about 4% lower with no headline to explain it, which puts price (51.66) near the 50.9 stop before any entry. RSI is 67 and price sits 10.9% above SMA20, so it is still stretched. The Q3 print was a slight revenue miss with opex up 35%, and litigation risk was flagged but not detailed. The regime is neutral with tech and growth under pressure from a 10-year yield at 5.05, although healthcare is the leading sector.
